ui.introduction: Share your experience with a game or application, or simply view your PC configuration.
ui.stage2: 2. Review the information · 3. Choose how to participate
ui.ready: Windows, graphics cards and their drivers are read locally. No account or driver installation is needed.
ui.readingHelp: Windows is gathering the information. You can continue to use this window.
ui.options: Information to include in the preview and report:
ui.idsHelp: Card model codes for researchers. No serial number or unique PC identifier.
ui.emptyPreview:
Your report will appear here.

You can choose which sections to share before saving or copying it.

This tool does not collect account names, PC names or serial numbers. It sends no data.

It describes the configuration: it does not test performance or guarantee game or application compatibility.

You can also join without a report using the Join on GitHub button.
ui.complete: Reading is complete. Review your report and choose what you would like to share.
ui.partial: Some information is unavailable. The report shows what could be read; you can still participate.
ui.failed: Windows could not provide the information. Try again or join the project without a report.
ui.timeout: Windows is taking longer than expected. You can close the tool or join without a report. You can retry when Windows finishes.
ui.retry: The delayed reading has been discarded. You can retry or join without a report.
ui.shareHelp: The form opens in your browser. You can paste the copied report there. Nothing is sent automatically. GitHub contributions are public and require a GitHub account.
ui.footer: Prototype 0.3 · Independent community · Kepler, Maxwell and Pascal owners and other contributors are welcome.
ui.copied: Report copied. You can paste it in the GitHub form or a message of your choice.
ui.updated: Report changed. Copy or save this new version: previous copies still contain the old information.
ui.opened: Form opened in your browser. No report data was transmitted.
ui.saveError: The report could not be saved. Choose a folder you can write to, or use Copy the report.
ui.copyError: The clipboard is temporarily unavailable. Try again or save the report.
